text: Within the MCP Tool Collection, the pipeline starts with the designated correct tools.
These are combined with a set of distractor tools.
Both streams merge into the candidate tool list.
In parallel, the task set provides a suite of real-world tasks.
Both candidate tools and tasks feed directly into the AutoGen-based Sandbox.
Inside the sandbox, dynamic MCP tool loading is initiated.
The sandbox runs local MCP servers.
This architecture enables stable and reproducible execution.
The sandbox communicates bidirectionally with the LLM-based Agent via tool calls and execution feedback.
The agent first processes task understanding.
It then proceeds to tool selection.
Next, the agent completes parameter generation.
Outputs from the agent flow into the Evaluation and Scoring module.
